comparison.objective: Crack an egg on a bowl rim, pull its shell apart, deposit contents, and tray both shell halves.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual impact initiation, controlled separation, and sorting of contents and fractured shell.
comparison.success_condition: Crack then open the egg, place yolk and at least five white drops in the bowl, place both shell halves only in the tray, retract, and hold still.
comparison.reason: This is the closest fracture-and-recovery record, but it tests deformable food opening by direct bimanual pulling and content separation; the candidate tests tool-mediated notch fracture inside retained precision inserts using stabilized mandrel impacts.
